medium.label: Needs attention
medium.effect: Reviewing lawyer must acknowledge before approval.

blocker.label: Blocker
blocker.effect: Cannot proceed online — offer a consultation.

triageRules.label: Interstate / overseas residence
triageRules.clientMessage: You live outside Queensland, so a lawyer will check this will works properly where you are.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Client resides outside QLD. Confirm the will effectively deals with their assets and whether local advice or a separate will is required.

triageRules.label: Overseas assets
triageRules.clientMessage: Because you hold assets overseas, a lawyer will make sure nothing is left unprotected in another country.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Overseas assets detected. A QLD will may not deal effectively with foreign property — consider separate situs wills and revocation wording.

triageRules.label: Child left out of will
triageRules.clientMessage: A lawyer will discuss this with you to make sure your wishes are clear and protected.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Child excluded from estate. Consider family provision exposure (Succession Act 1981 (Qld) Part 4); recommend detailed file note of reasons and advice on alternatives.

triageRules.label: Spouse / dependant left out
triageRules.clientMessage: A lawyer will talk this through with you and record your reasons properly — that's the best protection for your wishes.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Client intends to exclude an eligible applicant (spouse, de facto, child or dependant). Assess Part 4 exposure, record reasons, consider a statement of testamentary intention.

triageRules.label: Blended family
triageRules.clientMessage: Blended families need extra care, so a lawyer will check the wording protects everyone you intend to provide for.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Current partner plus children from a prior relationship. Elevated family provision risk; consider life interest, mutual wills or testamentary trust options.

triageRules.label: Minor beneficiaries
triageRules.clientMessage: Because children under 18 are involved, a lawyer will check the guardianship and trust wording.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Beneficiaries under 18. Confirm minors' trust provisions, trustee powers and guardianship appointment are consistent.

triageRules.label: Disability / NDIS / Centrelink beneficiary
triageRules.clientMessage: A lawyer will make sure an inheritance doesn't accidentally affect anyone's support payments.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Beneficiary with disability or means-tested support. Consider a Special Disability Trust or protective trust to preserve DSP/NDIS entitlements.

triageRules.label: Testamentary trust requested
triageRules.clientMessage: You've asked for money to be held in trust, so a lawyer will set that up carefully.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Testamentary trust requested or implied. Draft trust provisions, appoint trustee and appointor, confirm vesting age and tax treatment.

triageRules.label: Business / trust / SMSF
triageRules.clientMessage: Business and trust interests need specialist attention — a lawyer will review how they pass on.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Client controls a business, family trust or SMSF. These assets may not pass under the will. Confirm control succession, appointor role, buy/sell agreements and SMSF trusteeship.

triageRules.label: Super / life insurance nomination
triageRules.clientMessage: Super and life insurance don't always follow your will — a lawyer will point out what to check with your fund.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Superannuation death benefit or life insurance may pass outside the estate. Advise on binding nominations and whether proceeds should be directed to the estate.

triageRules.label: Tenants in common / structured property
triageRules.clientMessage: A lawyer will check how your property is held — it decides whether it passes under your will.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Property held as tenants in common, via a structure, or ownership unknown. Obtain title search; confirm whether the share passes under the will and how mortgage debt is borne.

triageRules.label: Gift of real property
triageRules.clientMessage: You're gifting property, so a lawyer will confirm the details and any mortgage.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Specific devise of real property. Confirm title, whether gift carries the mortgage (s 61 Succession Act), and ademption risk if sold before death.

triageRules.label: Crypto / digital asset gift
triageRules.clientMessage: Digital assets need a secure plan for access — a lawyer will arrange that alongside your will.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Crypto or digital assets present. Without private keys the gift fails. Arrange a confidential access memorandum; avoid placing keys in the will itself.

triageRules.label: Conditional gift / gift over
triageRules.clientMessage: You've added a condition to a gift — a lawyer will make sure it will actually work.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Conditional gift or gift-over structure. Check for uncertainty, repugnancy and public policy; confirm the condition is a condition subsequent or precedent as intended.

triageRules.label: Cash gifts large vs estate
triageRules.clientMessage: Your gifts are a sizeable share of your estate — a lawyer will check the residue still works as you intend.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Specific cash gifts exceed ~25% of the declared estate band. Advise on abatement risk and whether gifts should be proportionate rather than fixed.

triageRules.label: Executor under 18
triageRules.clientMessage: An executor must be at least 18. Let's find a better way forward together.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Executor under 18 cannot obtain a grant. Online path blocked; client directed to a consultation.

triageRules.label: Executor overseas
triageRules.clientMessage: Your executor lives overseas — a lawyer will suggest how to make their job easier.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Overseas executor. Probate, bank access and tax residency complications; recommend appointing a resident co-executor.

triageRules.label: Executor bankrupt / capacity concern
triageRules.clientMessage: A lawyer will talk through your executor choice with you — nothing is ruled out yet.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Executor bankrupt or possible incapacity. The court may refuse a grant; discuss substitution or a professional executor.

triageRules.label: Professional executor requested
triageRules.clientMessage: We'll send you a written quote for a professional executor before anything is finalised.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Client interested in a professional executor. Prepare fee quote and charging clause disclosure before approval.

triageRules.label: Executors not yet asked
triageRules.clientMessage: Worth telling the people you've named — we can help you do it.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Executors not yet informed. Nudge client; a renunciation after death causes months of delay.

triageRules.label: Unclear revocation / overseas will
triageRules.clientMessage: You have an earlier will, so a lawyer will make sure the new one fits together with it properly.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Existing will with overseas element or partial revocation requested. Confirm revocation wording does not inadvertently revoke foreign coverage; obtain copy of prior will.

triageRules.label: Recent / planned marriage
triageRules.clientMessage: Marriage can affect an existing will, so a lawyer will confirm the right wording for you.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Recent or contemplated marriage. s 14 Succession Act 1981 (Qld) — marriage revokes a will unless made in contemplation. Add contemplation clause if appropriate.

triageRules.label: Separation / settlement pending
triageRules.clientMessage: Because your separation isn't finalised, a lawyer will check what that means for your will.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Separation or property settlement incomplete. Former spouse may retain entitlements and a family provision claim; divorce will later affect gifts (s 15). Advise before approval.

triageRules.label: Capacity check (85+)
triageRules.clientMessage: We take extra care with every will — a senior lawyer will review yours personally.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Will-maker aged 85+. Consider contemporaneous capacity assessment, solicitor's certificate and detailed file note (Banks v Goodfellow).

triageRules.label: Possible undue influence
triageRules.clientMessage: We'd like to talk with you directly before going further — it's how we make sure your will is truly yours.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Person assisting the client is also a beneficiary. Undue influence / knowledge and approval risk. Online path blocked; arrange an interview with the client alone.

triageRules.label: Large estate
triageRules.clientMessage: For estates of this size, a senior lawyer reviews everything personally.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Estate exceeds the $2m threshold. Confirm CGT, testamentary trust and asset protection advice has been considered; senior sign-off required.

triageRules.label: 'Not sure' on a structural question
triageRules.clientMessage: You weren't sure about something important — a lawyer will help you work it out.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Client answered 'I'm not sure' on a structural question (property tenure, super nomination, residue or beneficiary status). Resolve before drafting.

triageRules.label: Inconsistent answers
triageRules.clientMessage: A couple of your answers don't quite line up — we'll help you tidy them before submitting.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Automated consistency checker found contradictions in the client's answers. Review the list on the matter before drafting.

triageRules.label: Large pet-care gift
triageRules.clientMessage: A lawyer will check the amount you've set aside for your pets is structured well.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Pet-care gift exceeds $20,000. Frequently challenged; consider a smaller sum with a non-binding wish, or a purpose trust analysis.

triageRules.label: Organ donation wish
triageRules.clientMessage: Remember to register your decision and tell your family — a will is usually read too late.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Organ donation wish recorded. Remind client the will is not an effective vehicle; direct to the Australian Organ Donor Register.

triageRules.label: Bespoke division / survivorship
triageRules.clientMessage: You've described something custom — a lawyer will draft it and confirm the wording with you.
triageRules.lawyerMessage: Client supplied free-text instructions for residue division or survivorship. Draft bespoke wording and confirm back to client in writing.

consistencyChecks.message: You said you don't have children, but you've named a guardian for children.
You chose to leave everything to a partner, but your relationship status is single, divorced or widowed.
You chose to split your estate between your children, but you haven't listed any children.
You said you don't have pets, but you've set money aside for pet care.
You said you don't want specific gifts, but gifts are still recorded on your matter.
You said you're leaving someone out, but haven't said who.
You asked for donations instead of flowers, but haven't named a charity.
You have a prepaid funeral, but haven't named the provider.
The shares of your residuary estate don't add up to 100%.
Someone you've named as executor also appears in the list of people you're not providing for.
